courses.title: Library Research Skills
courses.description: The course introduces skills needed to locate, evaluate, and cite information. The course focuses on the resources of academic libraries including online catalogs, periodical indexes, and instructional websites. This course will prepare students to do the basic research necessary to effectively complete written and oral assignments.
